title: Container build cannot find its source directory
root_cause: The Dockerfile changed the source of a COPY instruction from cmd/lichen to cmd/lichens, which is absent from the build context. BuildKit cannot compute the source checksum and stops before compiling the Go program. The successful baseline is on a divergent history, so the comparison cannot establish every intervening difference.

relevant_evidence.why: BuildKit cannot find the source of the COPY instruction.
The build copies the plural directory before compiling the singular package path.
